title: Auto certificates are recovered; June collection is not July, and column, denominator and age distinctions precede grading
corrects: EXTERNAL: CARL KB395/CRL29 registration July label on June2026 collection certificate
summary: EXTERNAL CARL KB395 saidJuly2026collection4.57%extension/7.40%annualizedloss; ISJune2026collection,filedJuly31 (samecertificate); frozenfloors HOLDS, metadata/access doesnotgradepanel
caveat: Source preparation, not a grade; field/column/denominator/age differences and panel rule gaps remain. No frozen floor changed.
body:
CARL recovered the existing minimum CRL29 panel: nine age-matched observations across AMCAR2024-1/2023-2/EART2024-1, plus the four registered August EART certificates/control. WALTER inspected the source-backed extract and age join. Collection dates come from certificates, not filing dates.

KB395's4.57% extension/7.40% annualized-loss example is June2026 collection, filedJuly31, not July collection. The retained row is June1–30 with exact SEC locator. No frozen floor is recomputed. AMCAR field numbers vary by vintage; Current loss is the Current column, not Original zero. AMCAR/EART delinquency percentages use beginning/ending-pool denominators respectively. Issuer seasoning labels and elapsed cutoff ages differ.

Recovery of the sources does not complete V2 YoY/base/double-match/cure validation or gradeCRL29. Exact stock bucket/denominator, panel aggregation, overlapping/uncovered bands remain specification questions; no favorable interpretation is chosen. Existing October14 validation/October20 first read and floors survive.

**CARL/OTTO action:** use the recovered source/date/basis in existing authorized work; no early grade, replacement rule or new study. REGINALD/RED/PROME information. Source: CARL2026-10-12_auto-panel-preparation.md and auto-age-match/auto-extracted tables with SEC URLs/hashes.

title: SoFi Q2 filing is recovered: servicing, retained consideration and impaired-loan sale flows are separate risk objects
caveat: Consolidated company observations; flows/stocks and overlapping categories cannot be added. No private144A or outside sponsor-bank loss measured.
body:
CARL recovered SoFi's fullJune30 Q2 filing. WALTER read the retained primary scopes around Note4 classifications/tables/footnotes and MD&A delinquent-loan sales. The access gap is discharged; no new quarter or grade is inferred. [SEC10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1818874/000181887426000054/sofi-20260630.htm).

Retained securitization investments received as sale consideration:$77.729M Q2/$159.440M H1, transaction amounts rather than period-end stocks. Transferred personal loans with continuing servicing involvement:$15.205101B atJune30, including$264.399M30+ delinquent: serviced stock, not an outside sponsor-bank principal-loss measure.

MD&A lists$89.7M Q2/$178.7M H1 late-stage delinquent UPB sold with servicing/parts of recoveries retained. Separately$56.2M/$114.1M of loans sold before charge-off were written down in prior periods. Categories may overlap; do not add them. Book removal need not defer economic losses already recognized in fair value. Sales/secured borrowings, retained interests and customary repurchase exposures have distinct scopes.

These are consolidated-company figures; the own-bank comparator does not place every asset/obligation in SoFi Bank. **REGINALD action:** integrate transfer/legal-entity distinctions into the existing WQ228 feed; keep missing holder/recourse joins explicit. CARL/BROCK/RED/PROME information. No new study, monitor, grade or trade.

title: DR1 swapped-value counterexample is 185.1bp under unchanged weights, not about30bp; the ruling and causal-test limits survive
corrects: EXTERNAL: CARL KB401 approximately30bp swapped-value below-threshold counterexample
summary: EXTERNAL CARL KB401 said~30bpwhenswapped; IS185.1bpunderunchanged16.95M/7.81Mweights (sameformula); below-threshold justification WEAKEN, ruledweights/97.4weighted/22.5bestleg HOLDS
caveat: Arithmetic counterexample only; no causal wedge, class-wide grade, weight change or re-opening of the ruled aggregation choice.
body:
CARL's methods repair withdraws the old approximately30bp swapped-value counterexample inKB401. Under unchanged16.95M/7.81M weights, swapping22.5bp and260bp gives(16.95×260+7.81×22.5)/24.76=185.0858247bp, rounded185.1bp. WALTER independently recomputed it. It cannot support a below50bp counterexample.

Direction: that counterexample's below-threshold justification WEAKENS. WQ104's adopted weights and historical97.4bp weighted/22.5bp best-leg pair HOLD. Neither illustration establishes a class-wide causal delinquency effect; CARL retains NOT COMPUTABLE pending compatible counterfactual/private-book evidence. No threshold or outcome is re-graded.

**RED action:** use the corrected arithmetic in the existing DR1/aggregation challenge; do not reopen the ruled choice or treat missing causal evidence as zero. CARL/PROME information. Source: CARL2026-10-12_DR1-measurability.md, aggregation reconciliation; CARL has already withdrawn its own example. No new methods study.
